NFC: Combines letters and accents where possible. A good default for comparing and storing text.
NFD: Separates letters from their combining accents, for inspecting how text is represented.
NFKC: Combines letters and accents and folds compatibility characters. For example, Ａ becomes A, ① becomes 1, and ﬁ becomes fi.
NFKD: Separates letters from their combining accents and folds compatibility characters such as Ａ, ①, and ﬁ.
inputPlaceholder: Type or paste text to normalize
codePointsLimit: Showing up to 40 code points from each text.
